annotation.title_clean: Projeto de Lei nº 842/2024 - Altera a Lei nº 12.965/2014 (Marco Civil da Internet) para obrigar sinalização de conteúdos audiovisuais gerados por inteligência artificial
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 842/2024 - Amends Law No. 12,965/2014 (Internet Civil Framework) to require labelling of AI-generated audiovisual content
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian bill PL 842/2024 amends the Marco Civil da Internet to require internet applications using AI to generate audio or audiovisual content to display clear, continuous labelling that content is AI-generated, with consumer-protection penalties for non-compliance. Motivated by deepfake scams and fraud.
key_provisions_or_claims: New Art. 29-A requires clear labelling throughout AI-generated audio/audiovisual content
New user right (Art. 7 XIV) to be informed content is AI-generated
Non-compliance treated as consumer-protection infringement under Lei 8.078/1990, plus civil and criminal liability
Labelling may be by watermark or caption present for the full duration
Enters into force 90 days after publication
